messages.translation: Failed to read directory: {msg} (if the directory does not exist yet, it will be created when you upload)

messages.source:
将打开雨课堂官方作答页完成提交。

附件要在官方页里再选一次；页面内是雨课堂官方提交逻辑（含其自身的截止/次数校验与二次确认），请在其中确认后提交。关闭或返回后回到本面板。
messages.translation:
The official Rain Classroom answer page will open to complete the submission.

Attachments must be selected again on that page; the page uses Rain Classroom's official submission flow (including its own deadline/attempt checks and a second confirmation). Confirm and submit there. Closing or going back returns to this panel.
One more step needed from you

messages.limitHint: Keep concise; button/card label may wrap.

messages.source: 把附件作为**一条完整消息**发给 OH（不弹输入框，直接发）。{value}开关位置：设置 → 插件 → OneTHU Harness → 多模态。
messages.translation: Sends the attachments to OH as **one complete message** (no input prompt, sent directly). {value} Switch location: Settings → Plugins → OneTHU Harness → Multimodal.

messages.source: 云盘还没连接，请先到「云盘」页连接清华云盘再转存。
messages.translation: Cloud Drive is not connected yet. Connect Tsinghua Cloud Drive on the "Cloud Drive" page first, then save over there.

messages.translation: Select a course and an assignment first (the assignment must belong to the selected course)

messages.translation: Only one file can be submitted per assignment; the first one is used here: {name}

messages.translation: {value}At most 4 images per message and 6MB per image; anything over the limit will be explained in the message body (never silently dropped).
